name: Zillow Bridge API
tagline: MLS and public-record property data via Zillow’s Bridge platform for licensed partners.
description: Zillow Bridge (Bridge Data Output) provides licensed partners with MLS listing and public-record property data through a REST API. Access is partner-only; authentication and endpoints follow Bridge Data Output docs for property, listing, and assessment resources.

auth.details: API key via access_token query param or Authorization header; partner signup required (not fully self-serve).

use_cases: fetch MLS listings for a market
look up property public records by address
sync listing status and price changes
query property assessments and tax data
